evidence_snippets: Google Workspace add-ons are limited to Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Meet, Docs, Sheets, and Slides, and must use card-based interfaces, not HTML/CSS.
Google Workspace add-ons The following restrictions only apply to Google Workspace add-ons and the use of the Card service .
Google Workspace add-ons use a card-based interface system, rather than traditional HTML, CSS, or client-side scripting.
